detail.longDescription: 🔗 Link Dump #79 A roundup of interesting links I have enjoyed recently. Games powered by Wikidata: wikidata.org 1 TV debloater: cleanyour.tv 2 Local Wikipedia: edjefferson.com An office suite with no accounts and no servers: tinylittleoffice.com Open source creative tools: getartcraft.com Things that are good to do: quarter–mile.com 118 things to do instead of doomscrolling: nytimes.com A curriculum to teach yourself computer science: github.com An interactive tree of life explorer: ptree.org A pixel-art map of Valencia, Spain: tinyvalencia.com 3 I especially like WikiTrivia. ↩︎ Enshittification is here for our televisions. This can help. ↩︎ Related: Notes from my stay in Valencia. ↩︎
